issue.name: Cross-site scripting (reflected)
issue.issueBackground: Reflected cross-site scripting vulnerabilities arise when data is copied from a request and echoed into the application's immediate response in an unsafe way.
issue.remediationBackground: In most situations where user-controllable data is copied into application responses, cross-site scripting attacks can be prevented using two layers of defenses: input validation and output encoding.
issue.vulnerabilityClassifications:
• CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
  • CWE-80: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS)
issue.issueDetail: The value of the q request parameter is copied into the HTML document as plain text between tags.

issue.name: Strict transport security not enforced
issue.issueBackground: The application fails to prevent users from connecting to it over unencrypted connections.
issue.remediationBackground: The application should instruct web browsers to only access the application using HTTPS. To do this, enable HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) by adding a response header with the name 'Strict-Transport-Security' and the value 'max-age=expireTime'.

issue.name: Cacheable HTTPS response
issue.issueBackground: Unless directed otherwise, browsers may store a local cached copy of content received from web servers.
issue.remediationBackground: Applications should return caching directives instructing browsers not to store local copies of any sensitive data.

issue.name: Cleartext submission of password
issue.issueBackground: Some applications transmit passwords over unencrypted connections, making them vulnerable to interception.
issue.remediationBackground: Applications should use transport-level encryption (SSL or TLS) to protect all sensitive communications passing between the client and the server.
issue.issueDetail:
The page contains a form with the following action URL, which is submitted over clear-text HTTP:
  • http://intranet.example.gov.tw:8080/login
issue.remediationDetail: Move the login form to HTTPS.
